scope: Wave2 native Properties picker request ownership and honest lookup errors
observedSourceMechanism: SearchView.task(id:) cancels superseded queries; PropertyCreationViewModel previously published after multiple awaits without cancellation or request identity checks.
Native catalog caught CancellationError as a failed search and could enter bootstrap retry; ordinary relation failures were silently converted to empty arrays.
An unresolved canonical/order identity could permit internal descriptors into the visible ordinary list.
changes: Move downstream catalog lookup into a cancellable loader; only current picker request may publish rows or failures.
Abort native catalog work at cancellation boundaries before provisioning retry or diagnostic publication.
Retain native property formats and ordinary choices when the Torah catalog fails; show localized independent lookup errors and suppress misleading empty-result copy.
Keep canonical/order descriptors hidden unless their real Space identities have resolved.
justification: The original picker owns rendered rows and error/empty state. It needs a narrow latest-request publication hook and optional empty-state visibility; catalog/domain behavior remains in downstream Pinkha files. SearchView default behavior is unchanged.
ownerAuthorization: User Wave2 execution mandate and repository standing owner authorization of 2026-11-19.
requiredRemaining: Compile source in shared Mac producer
Actual Add Property/empty canonical selector/native preservation UI acceptance
